notes: Scoped to the 12-table lifecycle raw dataset (data/lifecycle/raw/) only -- separate from context/validation_rules.json, which governs the original 3-scenario customers/loans/payments model and is unmodified.
Only schema, enum, and referential_integrity checks exist here. No reconciliation checks -- those compare a curated/ETL output against raw data, and no curated output exists yet for this model.

Executed by src/validate_lifecycle_raw.py, which is the actual authority on these checks -- this file only documents ids/descriptions, consistent with how context/validation_rules.json relates to src/legacy/validate_portfolio.py.

rules.description: lifecycle customers data must contain all required columns: customer_id, created_at, state, income_band, credit_score_band, credit_score, risk_segment.
campaigns data must contain all required columns: campaign_id, name, channel, start_date, end_date, target_risk_segment.
coupon_rules data must contain all required columns: coupon_rule_id, coupon_code, campaign_id, discount_type, discount_value, valid_from, valid_to.
email_events data must contain all required columns: event_id, campaign_id, customer_id, event_type, event_timestamp.
prequal_offers data must contain all required columns: offer_id, customer_id, campaign_id, coupon_code, offer_amount, offer_apr, created_at, expires_at.
applications data must contain all required columns: application_id, customer_id, offer_id, requested_amount, submitted_at, application_status.
underwriting_decisions data must contain all required columns: decision_id, application_id, decision, rejection_reason, approved_amount, approved_apr, model_version, decided_at.
lifecycle loans data must contain all required columns: loan_id, application_id, customer_id, principal_amount, interest_rate, term_months, originated_at, loan_status, scheduled_payment_amount.
payment_schedule data must contain all required columns: schedule_id, loan_id, installment_number, due_date, scheduled_amount.
payment_events data must contain all required columns: event_id, schedule_id, loan_id, event_type, payment_date, amount, payment_status, payment_method.
delinquency_events data must contain all required columns: delinquency_id, loan_id, as_of_date, days_past_due, bucket.
defaults data must contain all required columns: default_id, loan_id, default_date, balance_at_default, recovery_amount, recovery_date.
Every campaigns.channel value must be within business_rules.valid_channels.
Every coupon_rules.discount_type value must be within business_rules.valid_discount_types.
Every email_events.event_type value must be within business_rules.valid_email_event_types.
Every applications.application_status value must be within business_rules.valid_application_statuses.
Every underwriting_decisions.decision value must be within business_rules.valid_decision_values.
Every non-null underwriting_decisions.rejection_reason value must be within business_rules.valid_rejection_reasons.
Every lifecycle loans.loan_status value must be within business_rules.valid_loan_statuses (the same key the original 3-scenario model uses -- the vocabulary is unchanged).
Every payment_events.event_type value must be within business_rules.valid_payment_event_types.
Every payment_events.payment_status value must be within business_rules.valid_payment_event_statuses.
Every delinquency_events.bucket value must be within business_rules.valid_delinquency_buckets.
Every coupon_rules.campaign_id must reference an existing campaigns.campaign_id.
Every email_events.campaign_id must reference an existing campaigns.campaign_id.
Every email_events.customer_id must reference an existing customers.customer_id.
Every prequal_offers.customer_id must reference an existing customers.customer_id.
Every non-null prequal_offers.campaign_id must reference an existing campaigns.campaign_id (null means an organic, non-campaign offer).
Every applications.customer_id must reference an existing customers.customer_id.
Every non-null applications.offer_id must reference an existing prequal_offers.offer_id (null means an organic application).
Every underwriting_decisions.application_id must reference an existing applications.application_id.
Every lifecycle loans.application_id must reference an existing applications.application_id.
Every lifecycle loans.customer_id must reference an existing customers.customer_id.
Every payment_schedule.loan_id must reference an existing lifecycle loans.loan_id.
Every payment_events.loan_id must reference an existing lifecycle loans.loan_id.
Every non-null payment_events.schedule_id must reference an existing payment_schedule.schedule_id.
Every delinquency_events.loan_id must reference an existing lifecycle loans.loan_id.
Every defaults.loan_id must reference an existing lifecycle loans.loan_id.
